name: UFACTORY xArm Gripper
price_basis: assumed low-cost equivalent of the listed part: 5 x sqrt(list price), to the nearest $5 (see catalog/README.md, Prices)
notes: mass_kg is the figure the Payload check charges against the arm; the composed model uses the simulator model's own mass. force_n is the range of grip force it can hold. hold says how it carries an object. The tool point is tool_offset_m out from the arm's flange along its z axis.
